references.notes: Residential sources of diverted materials (recycling) = 5,894,374 tonnes. Waste disposed of from residential sources (10,698,180 tonnes). 97% of waste requiring final disposal is sent to landfills and 3% is incinerated, therefore: Landfilled - 10,698,180*0.97 = 10,377,235 tonnes. Incinerated - 10,698,180*0.03 = 320,945 tonnes.
